candidates.text: Write each proposed map with domain and codomain, show well-definedness, and identify its kernel. A holonomy label or vocabulary ordering does not provide these constructions.

candidates.text: Separate a feasible dual lower bound from an optimal primal-dual certificate. Compute the residual, objective, dual constraints and objective equality before claiming optimality or applying a terminal policy.
candidates.observed_failure: Feasible weak bounds were called attained optima, and static obstruction was confused with policy-dependent halting.

candidates.text: An upper envelope does not establish sharp propagation or an interior signal. State the uniform and boundary-rate assumptions before a refinement limit, and distinguish causal order from metric scale.
candidates.observed_failure: The finite causal witness can be right while the limiting theorem is incomplete or overstated.
